'''''Journal of Differential Equations''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published semi-monthly by [[Elsevier]]. Established in 1965,<ref>{{cite journal  |title=Editorial board |journal=Journal of Differential Equations |date=1965 |volume=1 |issue=1 |pages=1 |doi=10.1016/0022-0396(65)90024-0}}</ref> it focuses on the theory and the application of [[differential equation]]s.<ref name="overview">{{cite web |title=Aims and scope: Journal of Differential Equations|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-differential-equations/about/aims-and-scope |website=sciencedirect.com |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |access-date=August 25, 2026}}</ref> Its current [[editor-in-chief|editors-in-chief]] are [[Adrian Constantin]] ([[University of Vienna]]), Kening Lu ([[Sichuan University]]) and [[Juncheng Wei]] ([[Chinese University of Hong Kong]]).<ref name="editorial">{{cite web |title=Editorial board: Journal of Differential Equations |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-differential-equations/about/editorial-board |website=sciencedirect.com |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |access-date=August 25, 2026}}</ref>

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in:
*[[Current Contents]]/Physical, Chemical & Earth Sciences<ref name=ISI/>
*[[EBSCO Information Services|EBSCO databases]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[Ei Compendex]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[Inspec]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[MathSciNet]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[Science Citation Index Expanded]]<ref name=ISI>{{cite web |url=http://mjl.clarivate.com/ |title=Web of Science Master Journal List |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |work=Intellectual Property & Science |access-date=August 24, 2026}}</ref>
*[[Scopus]]<ref name=MIAR>{{cite MIAR |title= Journal of Differential Equations |issn= 0893-9659 |access-date=August 25, 2026}}</ref>
*[[zbMATH Open|zbMATH]]<ref name=MIAR/>

According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2025 [[impact factor]] of 2.3.<ref name="WoS">{{cite book |year=2026 |chapter= Journal of Differential Equations |title=2025 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |edition=Science |via=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports}}</ref>
